ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the input x[n] enters the left adder from the left side; the output of the left adder goes right along the upper main branch, and is labeled r[n] at that node. From r[n], there is a downward branch passing through the delay unit D and reaching the lower node; this delayed signal is fed back to the left adder along the lower left branch with gain -4, and is input to the right adder along the lower right branch with gain 1. Then reason: according to the feedback relationship in the figure, r[n] is the output of the left adder, equal to the input x[n] plus the feedback term -4r[n-1], so r[n]=x[n]-4r[n-1]. The system is initially at rest, therefore r[-1]=0. Given x[n]=δ[n], then r[0]=1-4r[-1]=1; when n>=1, x[n]=0, so r[n]=-4r[n-1]. From this, r[n]=(-4)^n u[n] is obtained. Comparing with the given r[n]=a^n u[n], a=-4.

method.method_draft: From the image, first identify r[n] as the signal immediately after the left summer and before the delay branch. Since the delayed branch returns to the left summer with gain -4, write the time-domain equation r[n]=x[n]-4r[n-1]. From the text, substitute x[n]=delta[n] and initial rest r[-1]=0. Then r[0]=1 and for n>=1, r[n]=-4r[n-1], giving r[n]=(-4)^n u[n]. Compare this with the given r[n]=a^n u[n] to obtain a=-4.

method.method_draft: After reading the image structure, form the z-domain relation for the left feedback loop: R(z)=X(z)+(-4)z^{-1}R(z). Hence R(z)/X(z)=1/(1+4z^{-1}). From the text, x[n]=delta[n], so X(z)=1 and R(z) is the impulse response of this loop. Expand the causal transfer function as R(z)=1-4z^{-1}+16z^{-2}-...; therefore r[n]=(-4)^n u[n]. Matching the given r[n]=a^n u[n] gives a=-4.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 x[n] 从左侧进入左边的加法器；左加法器的输出沿上方水平线向右传播，并在中间节点处标为 r[n]。从 r[n] 的中间节点向下有一条支路进入标有 D 的延时块，延时块输出到下方节点。下方节点向左经过标注为 -4 的支路反馈到左加法器，向右经过标注为 1 的支路送到右加法器；右加法器输出为 y[n]。推理：只需分析左侧反馈环。D 表示一个采样延时，所以反馈到左加法器的信号在 z 域中为 (-4)z^{-1}R(z)。因此左环满足 R(z)=X(z)+(-4)z^{-1}R(z)，即 R(z)/X(z)=1/(1+4z^{-1})。当 x[n]=delta[n] 时，X(z)=1，所以 R(z)=1/(1+4z^{-1})。系统因果且初始静止，按负幂展开得 R(z)=1-4z^{-1}+16z^{-2}-64z^{-3}+...，对应 r[n]=(-4)^n u[n]。与题设 r[n]=a^n u[n] 比较，得到 a=-4。
